title: fix(console): after a language switch, date cells format in the new language, not the stale server locale
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_
Fixes #27498
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:头像菜单切换语言后,console 的本地化提供者在「本人 sys_user 行被写入」时重新读取 `/auth/me/localization`;日期格式化器仍只有一个(`formatDate` 经 `useDisplayLocale`),未新增第二个。
- 为什么改:切换语言会先换界面语言、触发 console 重挂载,再写 `sys_user.locale`;重挂载发出的读取可能先于写入到达服务器,拿回旧的 `en-US` 并整个会话保留,于是中文界面下表格日期显示 `Oct 11`,整页加载才变 `2026年10月11日`。
- 风险与回滚:只动 console 一个文件,写入本人 sys_user 行时多一次 GET;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx`(新的 `useDataInvalidation` 依赖与 `signal` 一行);`LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx` 新的 describe 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx`,预期 18 个测试全绿,其中 4 个新用例名以 `re-reads after a write` 开头。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`LocalizationFetchProvider` (console) now reads `GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` again whenever the signed-in user's own `sys_user` row is written through the data-invalidation bus, and that re-read opts out of joining a request still in flight from before the write.

**Cause, measured on a running stack.** The endpoint's `locale` is the caller's language: their own `sys_user.locale` when set, else the request's `Accept-Language`, else the deployment default. `useDisplayLocale` ranks it above the active UI language, and every grid / record date renderer formats with it. The avatar-menu switch (`useLanguageSelection`) changes the UI language first and writes `sys_user.locale` second. The UI-language change remounts the metadata subtree (`key={language}` in `ConnectedShellInner`), which remounts this provider, and the remount's read can reach the server before the column write commits. It then answers the previous language (for a user with no stored language yet, the browser's `Accept-Language`, `en-US`), and nothing ever read again. Result: Chinese headers, chips and footer (all `t`-driven) beside `Oct 11` / `Nov 1` / `Nov 18` dates, until a full page load re-read the now-written column.

**Why the record page differed.** It is not a second formatter and not grid-specific. The record page reads the same `useDisplayLocale`; the walkthrough's record page was a fresh page load, whose boot read sees the committed column. Reached in the same session by clicking the row, the record page also read `Oct 11, 2026` before this change (measured below).

**Fix at the cause.** The provider subscribes with `useDataInvalidation('sys_user', userId)` (the same bus `useSignedInUserLocale` already reads; every adapter write reaches it through `useMutationInvalidationBridge`). The language switch's own write therefore triggers a read that starts after the write has settled. Because `sharedGetJson` shares a promise with any overlapping GET of the same URL, a re-read passes an `AbortController` signal, which opts it out of sharing (and aborts it if superseded or unmounted); the boot read keeps sharing with `seedTenantLanguage()` (objectui#5544). The existing `cancelled` guard drops a stale answer that settles late; the catch now returns first when cancelled so an abort is not treated as a transient failure. The profile page's language card writes the same row and is covered by the same subscription.

The ruling "Format grid date cells through the same locale-aware formatter the record page uses. No second date formatter." holds: no formatter, renderer or `useDisplayLocale` line changed.

## Tests

New `describe` block in `ui/apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx`, probing `useDisplayLocale()` plus `formatDate('2026-10-11', undefined, { locale, alwaysShowYear: true })`, the face a grid cell paints:

- `a read that lost the race with the language write is replaced after the write`: boot read answers `en-US` (`Oct 11, 2026`), a `sys_user` write for the signed-in user re-reads, the probe shows `zh-CN|2026年10月11日`.
- `the re-read does not join a request still in flight from before the write`: the boot read is held pending; the write's re-read issues its own request and lands `zh-CN`; the held request settling late with `en-US` is dropped.
- `a write to another user's row reads nothing again` and `signed out, a sys_user write reads nothing again`.

The block resets the shared in-flight registry after each case, so a pending request from a failing case cannot be joined by the next one.

<details><summary>Targeted runs and ablations (head eda50a4a, before the main merge; re-run after it in Verification)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx` → `Tests 18 passed (18)`; with `apps/console/src/__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx` → `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 21 passed (21)`.
- Ablation 1, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: effect dependencies `[endpoint, userRowWrites]` → `[endpoint]` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed). Red: `a read that lost the race…` and `the re-read does not join…`. Restored; file hash equal to HEAD's.
- Ablation 2: delete `signal: reread?.signal,` (anchor 1 → 0). Red: `the re-read does not join a request still in flight from before the write` only (`Tests 1 failed | 17 passed`). Restored; hash equal to HEAD's.
- No `dist` involved: the console suite resolves the provider and `@object-ui/*` from source.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Same symptom, second door, not fixed here (reported to the seat):** a signed-in user with no stored `sys_user.locale` whose UI language comes from the device (for example 中文 picked on the sign-in page) gets `Nov 18` dates under Chinese headers on every load, deterministically: the endpoint answers the `Accept-Language` rung (`en-US`), and `useDisplayLocale` ranks it above the UI language. Measured on this stack with the column reset to null and `objectui-locale` = `zh`. Closing it means changing `useDisplayLocale`'s documented precedence or having the endpoint say which rung answered, a design call outside this card.
- The `useDisplayLocale` docblock says the tenant locale is "Frequently `undefined`"; on this stack an authenticated read always answered a locale (`en-US` from the header or deployment rung). Not edited here.
- The object description staying English under zh-CN (`A unit of work inside a project.`) is the showcase bundle's coverage, out of scope per the card.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live reproduction, app-showcase on this branch (backend :4127 --fresh, console vite :5197 from ui/apps/console source)</summary>

Script: sign in as admin in an `en-US` browser, open `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task` (All Tasks), avatar menu → Language → 中文, read the Due Date cells; click "Audit current IA" (same session); then load that record URL fresh. The `sys_user` PATCH was held 1.5 s by a Playwright route to make the race deterministic; a second run held it 0 s. Column reset to null before each run.

Before the fix (head 556f3230, delay 1.5 s):
- `/auth/me/localization` answers: `en-US`, `en-US`, `en-US` (remount read), then the PATCH `{"locale":"zh-CN"}` lands.
- Header `截止日期`; cells `Nov 18, Nov 8, Nov 1, Nov 28, Oct 11, Oct 31`.
- Record page reached by click: `Oct 11, 2026`. Same record by URL load: `2026年10月11日`, and the grid behind it `11月18日, 11月8日…`.

After the fix (delay 1.5 s):
- Answers: `en-US`, `en-US`, PATCH released, `en-US` (the remount's stale read), `zh-CN` (the re-read).
- Cells `11月18日, 11月8日, 11月1日, 11月28日, 10月11日, 10月31日`; record by click `2026年10月11日`; by URL load `2026年10月11日`.

After the fix, delay 0: cells `11月18日…`, record by click and by URL `2026年10月11日`.

</details>
